description: Loan-officer competitive-landscape report: ranked roster of the top N lenders publishing a given mortgage product in a state today — per-lender rows (name, best APR/rate, product, position, bps above the leader) — plus the market min/median/max. The market median is INSTITUTION-level — one vote per lender, using each lender's best APR (basis = total_lenders, not market.count) — so a lender publishing a large rate matrix cannot pull it. Extends get_benchmarks (which returns only min/median/max + the single lowest institution) with the full ranked table.

include_institution_context.description: Include compact NCUA member, location, asset, founding-year, and selected service facts per lender.

limit.description: Top N lenders to return (default 10, clamped 1..50)

state.description: 2-letter US state code, e.g. CA, TX, NY

name: get_league_table

as_of.description: UTC timestamp of the underlying rate data. This is when the rates were last scraped from lender sites, not when this call ran.

limit.description: Maximum rows the caller asked for.

market.description: Distribution across all lenders publishing this product, including those below the table cutoff.

count.description: Number of offers behind the market statistics. It can exceed total_lenders when a lender publishes several matching products.

max_apr.description: Highest APR in percent in the whole market.

median_apr.description: Median APR in percent across the whole market; use this, not min_apr, as 'the going rate'.

min_apr.description: Lowest APR in percent in the whole market for this product.

metric.description: Value the ranking is sorted by — 'apr' ranks by true cost including fees, 'rate' by the note rate alone.

note.description: Plain-English interpretation of the numbers above, already phrased for the user; quote it rather than re-deriving the comparison.

product.description: Product key the table ranks, e.g. '30yr_fixed'.

state.description: Two-letter US state code the result is scoped to (e.g. 'CA'). Null means the result was not filtered by state.

table.description: Lenders ranked best-first by the chosen metric.

apr.description: Annual percentage rate in percent, including lender fees. NULL when the lender published no APR — the API deliberately does not substitute the note rate, so never present `rate` as an APR. Some legacy rows still carry an APR equal to the note rate; those heal on that credit union's next scrape.

as_of.description: UTC timestamp when this lender's rate was last scraped.

best.description: True on the single top-ranked row.

bps_above_leader.description: How far this row's metric sits above the leader, in basis points (3 = 0.03 percentage points). 0 marks the leader.

display_name.description: Normalized, human-readable product name for comparison across lenders.

eligibility.description: Membership-eligibility snapshot for this lender, including status, charter type, and confidence. A great rate is unusable if the user cannot join.

institution_context.description: NCUA call-report facts about the institution such as asset size, member count, branches, and year opened.

lender.description: Full name of the credit union.

points.description: Discount points required for this rate, where 1 point = 1% of the loan amount.

position.description: Rank in the table, 1 = best on the chosen metric.

product.description: Product key this row was matched on, matching the top-level `product`.

product_name.description: The lender's own wording for the product, e.g. 'VA 30 Year Fixed' — note it may be a program-restricted product.

rate.description: Note rate in percent, excluding fees. It can be lower than the APR on the same row.

rateapi_url.description: Public rateapi.dev profile page for this lender.

total_lenders.description: Number of lenders publishing this product in this state. `count` is the visible top slice of this larger set.
